faq: Can you get me to the first page of Google?
No one can promise that. We fix what we can control: structure, titles, speed and markup. Rankings also depend on content, competition and links, and we explain where your site stands in the report.
Premium includes a keyword map for your main pages. The smaller packages work with the keywords you already target, or we suggest terms based on what each page is about.
How much faster will my site get?
It depends on what is slowing it down. Large images and heavy scripts are the usual cause, and fixing them often makes a clear difference. We share a before and after test so you see real numbers.
Will you change my page addresses?
Only when there is a good reason. If we change one, we add a 301 redirect so old links and search results keep working. We list every change in the handover.
